notice: UNREVIEWED LABELS. Every case has reviewed false. A case counts as ground truth only after a verifier model that did not write it checks its label against the cited public source and sets reviewed to true. No named person reviews labels. Cases with a string label_source were written by an agent from THREAT-MODEL.md, consult/README.md and the test fixtures; they cite no independent source and must stay reviewed false. Cases with a label_source object cite a public incident write-up, repository, paper or on-chain record retrieved on or before labelCutoff, and never a list the catalog imports. Their synthetic fields are named in the description.

fields.input: Exactly what consult(request, policy, facts) takes.
fields.expected.failIds: Sorted ids of the checks with status FAIL.
fields.expected.unverifiedIds: Sorted ids of the checks with status UNVERIFIED.
fields.expected.band: green, amber or red, as read from the support score.
fields.policySha256: SHA-256 of the key-sorted JSON of input.policy. A policy edit changes the hash, so it forces a deliberate label review.
fields.policyVersion: Version tag of the policy set in this file. Bump it when any policy object changes.
fields.label_source: A string for an agent-written label. An object { url, kind, quote or line_ref, retrieved } for a label grounded in a public source. kind is incident, repo, paper or onchain.
fields.chain_evidence: Optional. Each public RPC read used to build the case: chainId, rpc, method, call, block and result, so a verifier can repeat it without an API key.
fields.reviewed: false until a verifier model confirms the label against label_source. true is allowed only with a label_source object.

cases.description: Real spoof token from the 3 May 2024 address poisoning: contract 0x7393 reports symbol ETH, name Ether and 6 decimals. Its Transfer log moved 50000 units from the victim to the lookalike 0xd9a1c378. The call bytes are rebuilt from that log; the original transaction was sent by the attacker, not signed by the victim. The catalog has no ETH token entry, so the token checks answer UNVERIFIED and the verdict is UNKNOWN, not DENY.

label_source.quote: the token had a custom design that allowed it to be transferred from an account without the user's consent

chain_evidence.call: Transfer logs from 0x1e227979 in blocks 19788556 to 19789150

label_source.quote: The event begins with an initial transfer on 3 May 2024 at 9:14 UTC from the victim (0x1E227) to 0xd9A1b, a seemingly benign address on the Ethereum blockchain. ... the victim made a second transfer, this time unknowingly to an address controlled by the scammer, 0xd9A1c
